description: This file defines base classes and dataclasses for observing frame flow within the Pipecat pipeline, including event data structures and an abstract base observer class for monitoring frame processing and transfer events.

classes.name: FrameProcessed
classes.description: Event data representing a frame being processed by a pipeline processor.

classes.name: FramePushed
classes.description: Event data representing a frame being transferred between processors.

classes.name: BaseObserver
classes.description: Abstract base class for pipeline frame observers that handle frame processing and transfer events.

methods.name: on_process_frame(self, data: FrameProcessed)
methods.description: Asynchronous method to handle frame processing events; meant to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: on_push_frame(self, data: FramePushed)
methods.description: Asynchronous method to handle frame push events; meant to be implemented by subclasses.
